paragraphs: Mentioned in [Beitzah 26b](https://www.sefaria.org/Beitzah.26b.6), where he recited mishnayot and garbled them. As for the reading R’ Abba bar Ikhoma in [Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 1:3](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Taanit.1.3.3), Hyman says that the patronymic there should read bar Avimi.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Bavli names Ada bar Ukhme as the transmitter of a garbled teaching. The linked Yerushalmi names Rav Ada bar Ikhuma in a different discussion, on the blessing for rain. Hyman prints R’ Abba bar Ikhoma in that comparison and proposes bar Avimi.
